response.rationale: Several T1 meta-analyses and reviews (Hattie 2007, Wisniewski 2020, van der Kleij 2015, VanLehn 2011, Adesope 2017) show feedback has a medium-to-large average effect on learning, which supports the claim, but the effect varies widely, about 32% of feedback effects are negative, and some entries are off-topic (Brier, Murphy, SMPY) or duplicated, so the support is qualified rather than unconditional.
